name: io.github.sukrutkrdg/x402-bazaar-mcp
description: Check, then act, on Base and NEAR: token-safety gates, then swaps at the best price — over x402.

environmentVariables.name: X402_CREDIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid credit token (ck_…) from the buy-credits service. Sent as the x-credit-token header; each call debits your balance. No wallet or signing needed. Recommended paid mode. Buyable with USDC on Base, or with USDC/USDT/NEAR on NEAR at https://402.com.tr/credits.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex private key of a Base wallet holding USDC. Used locally to sign x402 payments — never sent anywhere. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet. Optional: without it (and without a credit token) the server runs on the free tier.
